seoTitle: {name} Matchday Ferry to Old Trafford — Manchester River Cruises
seoDescription: Catch the matchday ferry to Old Trafford from {name} ({location}). Arrive at Trafford Wharf, a short walk from the ground. Book direct.
heading: Depart from {name}
intro: Board at {location} and cruise to Trafford Wharf — the stadium end, beside IWM North and a short walk from Old Trafford.

sections.heading: Boarding at {name}
body: The {name} ferry departs from {location}. Please arrive in good time to board ahead of departure.
sections.note: Exact boarding location, arrival time before departure and check-in details — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).

sections.heading: Arriving at Trafford Wharf
body: The ferry arrives at Trafford Wharf, at the stadium end of the ship canal beside IWM North — a short walk from Old Trafford.
sections.note: What happens on arrival, the walk to the ground, and return-journey boarding after the final whistle — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).

sections.heading: Getting to {name}
sections.note: Directions, nearest tram/parking and the exact boarding point for {name} — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).

sections.heading: Prefer to depart from {otherName}?
body: The {otherName} ferry departs from {otherLocation} and also arrives at Trafford Wharf.

strings.value: A Manchester River Cruises boat on the Manchester Ship Canal carrying passengers on the open top deck, with the Salford Quays skyline and Millennium Footbridge behind.
Booking opens once this departure is set up in Ventrata (TBC).
